name: Ancient Greece
title: Distributed Algorithms of Ancient Greece
people: the merchants, part-time legislators, soldiers and scholars of an ancient Greek island

hero.alt: A walled Greek town seen from above the sea: a temple on its hill, a harbour, and roads between the places where its people work.
hero.caption: The town of Paxos. Nobody here shares a room. Every message in every scene walks one of these roads.
